export function control(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean): number {
  if (a && b) {
    while (c) {
      if (a) break;
    }
  } else if (c) {
    return a ? 1 : 2;
  } else {
    throw new Error("no");
  }
  return 0;
}

export function nesting(a: boolean): void {
  if (a) { if (a) { if (a) { if (a) {} } } }
}
